notes: Director's cut for U1-E4 'Planting, Not Raiding' (script v5 FINAL, Maya+Marcus). 17 scenes. Each scene carries a 'turns' [start, end] partition of the 58 TTS turn files (t00..t57, including the two 5s self-test silences) — run refit_durations.py against the rendered turns dir to replace the estimated duration_sec values with measured sums (the mix is a straight concat, so this is exact). Visual grammar: KeywordPops on the exam terms (joint-stock company, the starving time, tobacco, headright system, House of Burgesses, Opechancanough); StatSlides for the 50% first-year deaths, the 60-of-500 starving time, and the quarter of the colony killed in 1622; imageslides for the 1607 landing, the De La Warr rescue, and the White Lion; stepsslide recap of the three boxes; displayheadline Q&A; quoteslide close. No blank backgrounds. Eyes-closed-safe.
